  function controlRadishLink() {

    // find the radish nutritional link in footer
    const links = document.querySelectorAll('footer a');

    let radishLink = null;

    links.forEach(link => {
      if (link.href.includes("myradish.com/nutritional-info")) {
        radishLink = link;
      }
    });

    if (!radishLink) return;

    // check if page has the marker
    const enabled = document.getElementById("enable-radish-db");

    if (!enabled) {
      // remove link if page not marked
      radishLink.style.display = "none";
    } else {
      // show link if marked
      radishLink.style.display = "inline-block";
    }
  }

  // run once
  controlRadishLink();

  // Squarespace loads sections dynamically, so watch DOM changes
  const observer = new MutationObserver(controlRadishLink);
  observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

});
